entities.name: Damir Škaro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Damir Škaro is a former Croatian amateur boxer and convicted rapist. He won the Light Heavyweight Bronze medal at the 1988 Olympic Games in Seoul for Yugoslavia, as well as a Croatian politician. He also competed at the 1980 Olympic Games and the 1984 Olympic Games.
